items.summary: NITI Aayog today released the report titled “Impact Assessment of PLI Schemes”, prepared in collaboration with the Indian Institute of Management, Ahmedabad as the knowledge partner. The report recognizes the PLI Scheme as a flagship policy intervention launched by the Government of India to enhance India’s manufacturing competitiveness, integrate Indian firms into global value chains, and…
items.title: NITI Aayog Launches Report on “Impact Assessment of PLI Schemes”

items.summary: Raksha Rajya Mantri Shri Sanjay Seth launched the revamped Gallantry Awards portal ( https://gallantryawards.gov.in ) in New Delhi on November 12, 2026. The portal is a dedicated digital initiative to honour the courage & supreme sacrifices of the Gallantry Awardees and preserve their legacy for future generations.
items.title: Raksha Rajya Mantri launches revamped Gallantry Awards portal
